meta.description: End-to-end pooled and single-cell CRISPR screen analysis from FASTQ to hit genes: library QC, guide counting, six-stage screen QC, method-matched hit calling across MAGeCK/BAGEL2/drugZ/JACKS/Chronos, copy-number and batch correction, and tier-based cross-method consensus, with branches to editing, single-cell, and in-vivo variants.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All outputs are technical assay-analysis guidance and the checked references retain their original, attributable citations; no fabricated biological results were reported.

practice_boundaries.detail: Every exercised branch concerns experimental screen design, quality control, or computational analysis rather than an individual diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: The repaired MLE example explicitly uses ten permutation rounds and warns that default-round near-boundary FDR calls require stability checking; replicate correlation is restricted to within-condition pairs.

code_usability.detail: The final-pass scripts executed current MAGeCK MLE, MAGeCK RRA, drugZ, JACKS flag, Chronos API, Python, and shell checks on the documented environment.

functional_suitability.note: All three open recommendations are corrected: MLE reliability, the replicate-Pearson threshold, and example discoverability.

reliability.note: The MLE default-round recovery path is now explicit; the remaining unavoidable runtime cost of higher permutation counts is accurately disclosed.

performance_context.note: The broad workflow remains compact for its scope, with a targeted pointer to detailed MLE guidance rather than duplicated prose.

agent_usability.note: The numeric QC gate is internally consistent, the Step 0 clarification gate is explicit, and the branch-specific recovery rows are actionable.

human_usability.note: The compact example is now discoverable and explicitly scoped, while the main workflow retains clear choice and recovery points.

security.note: No credential exposure, destructive workflow instruction, or raw user-string execution path was found.

maintainability.note: Threshold and example facts now have a clear canonical location; the workflow remains necessarily broad because it orchestrates several screen modalities.

agent_specific.note: The counted-input to RRA handoff, seeded BAGEL2 consensus, MLE reliability caveat, and preflight escape hatch compose cleanly across the workflow.

key_strengths: The final-pass MLE command is exercised on real HAP1 data with the explicit ten-round reliability setting required for near-boundary FDR interpretation.
The Step 2 count labels compose into the Step 6a RRA command and regenerate a biologically coherent 18,056-gene summary.
Technical replicate correlation is calculated only within condition groups, and the numeric QC threshold now agrees across all shipped documentation.
The complete runnable MAGeCK reference is now discoverable from the main workflow without displacing the mandatory QC and design gates.
